tasks.title: EMAIL-7 Gmail parity map for Microsoft OAuth
tasks.prompt:
# MISSAO
Read-only EMAIL-7 analysis. Map the existing Gmail mailbox OAuth implementation and identify the smallest Microsoft Graph OAuth parity patch without creating a parallel architecture.

# ARQUIVOS PERMITIDOS
backend/src/marketing/mailbox-gmail-oauth.service.ts, backend/src/marketing/mailbox-gmail-oauth-callback.controller.ts, backend/src/marketing/marketing-connect.controller.ts, backend/src/marketing/marketing.module.ts, backend/src/marketing/*spec.ts, backend/prisma/schema.prisma, docs/implementation/**

# ARQUIVOS PROIBIDOS
All files outside ARQUIVOS PERMITIDOS. Do not edit anything. Do not read .env files. Do not print secrets. Do not run migrations. Do not run destructive DB commands.

# PRE-LEITURA OBRIGATORIA
AGENTS.md, docs/implementation/kloel-cia-gap-inventory.md, docs/implementation/kloel-cia-vision-traceability.md V12, docs/implementation/kloel-cia-session-handoff.md.

# COMPORTAMENTO ESPERADO
No code changes. Produce file:line evidence for Gmail auth URL, callback, token persistence, status overlay, tests, and module wiring. Recommend exact files/functions for Microsoft parity.

# COMANDOS DE VALIDACAO PERMITIDOS
rg, sed, git diff --stat. No tests, no package install, no network, no git writes.

# CRITERIO DE SUCESSO
Report names the exact smallest patch and focused Jest tests for Microsoft OAuth auth-url plus token storage.

# CRITERIO DE FALHA
Any file edit, secret output, fake provider claim, or recommendation without file:line evidence.

# FORMATO DE RELATORIO
- Gmail parity map
- Microsoft smallest patch recommendation
- focused tests
- risks/remediation

# REGRAS DE SEGURANCA
Never print env values or secrets. Never use git reset/restore/clean/push. Redact tokens/keys if seen.

# REGRA DE CONFLITO
If repo evidence contradicts this prompt, stop and report the contradiction.
